answer: Fund shared grants with pairwise-bounded quadratic matching. Small gifts from many seats still earn a match, but the bonus between any two seats shrinks as their giving histories overlap: if a sparrow-sized seat and fifty twins always back the same projects in the same minute, their joint match collapses toward one donor's. A farm can whisper support for its own sonnet-writing project through a hundred clones and still earn barely more than one honest patron.
